messages:
Sofia R: heads-up from usability testing today — customers got confused by the "priority" chips in the routing editor. they expected lower-number = higher importance but our tooltip says the opposite. screenshot attached.

Ethan M: oof. that's a dangerous mismatch. what does the backend treat as higher priority?

Priya K: backend sorts descending (higher numeric = higher priority) because math. but product copy says "position 1 = top" which is ambiguous when combined with priority numbers.

Sofia R: immediate UX fixes i suggest: 1) unify on one model in the UI (either position-based or explicit priority number), 2) change label to "Rank (1 = top)" if we keep numbers, 3) show a helper text under the header: "Higher rank runs earlier."

Oliver T: engineering note: we store a 'rank' integer and also maintain an ordering array. we can make the UI treat numbers as display-only if we switch to position-first. low effort: change copy and add a visual indicator (chevron) for execution order.

Priya K: also validation: currently you can assign duplicate priority numbers and the simulator just runs in saved order which leads to nondeterministic behavior. we should block dupes or show a deterministic tiebreaker rule. proposal: inline validation that flags duplicates with message "Duplicate rank — ties will break by creation time. Consider reordering or using unique ranks." and a quick action to auto-normalize ranks.

Sofia R: love the inline validation idea. UX question: should the error be blocking (can't save) or advisory? testers found advisory confusing — they'd expect save to fail.

Ethan M: prefer advisory for flexibility but make it very visible and include a prominent CTA: "Normalize ranks" which will auto-assign 1..N in current visual order. also add a small confirmation modal if user tries to persist with duplicates: "Persisting will apply tie-breaks by creation time. Proceed?"

Priya K: for preview simulation: current simulator reads persisted state. can we do optimistic preview: when user reorders or normalizes ranks we send a temporary simulate request that returns the hypothetical route run. add a small yellow badge in the preview header: "Previewing unsaved changes" with a tooltip "This simulation reflects your current edits and won't be saved unless you persist."

Oliver T: implementation details: we can send POST /simulate with body { preview_snapshot: [...] }. keep a version token to avoid race. optimistic approach: apply UI changes locally immediately, fire simulate; if simulation fails, surface non-blocking banner: "Preview failed — reverted to last saved simulation" and allow retry. rollback only for simulator results, not for the draft UI state.

Sofia R: accessibility notes: A11y testers couldn't tell when a duplicate validation appeared — no aria-live announcements. we need aria-live region for validation and preview status changes. e.g., announce "2 validation issues, 1 duplicate rank" and "Previewing unsaved changes".

A11yBot: automated check: ensure aria-live="polite" for non-critical messages and aria-live="assertive" for blocking errors. Also ensure the Normalize action is reachable via keyboard and that the confirmation modal traps focus.

Priya K: copy suggestion for duplicate badge: instead of "Duplicate rank" use "Rank conflict" with small help text: "Conflicting ranks will be auto-resolved by creation time. Use Normalize to set explicit ranks." shorter and less alarming.

Ethan M: visual tweak: when duplicates exist, show a faint warning icon on the affected rule rows and a hover tooltip explaining the tie-breaker. keep color token accessible (WCAG AA).

Sofia R: agree. i'll update figma: change header to "Rank (1 = top)", add helper line under header, add yellow preview badge, and design the Normalize UX + modal. i'll also add aria-live examples in the proto.

Oliver T: i'll scope tickets: simulate endpoint + optimistic preview badge (1.5d), inline duplicate validation + normalize flow (2d), confirmation modal and a11y fixes (1d).

Priya K: will write acceptance criteria: must block save only if validation marked blocking (we'll start advisory), preview badge must appear on any unsaved reorder/normalize, aria-live must announce validation changes and preview mode.

Sofia R: perfect. i'll drop updated figma + test recording in this thread when ready. thanks everyone :sparkles:
